description: Source code for STM32F7xx HAL Flash driver, providing functions for flash memory programming, control, and error handling.

methods.name: FLASH_Program_DoubleWord
methods.description: Programs a 64-bit double word at a specified address.

methods.name: FLASH_Program_Word
methods.description: Programs a 32-bit word at a specified address.

methods.name: FLASH_Program_HalfWord
methods.description: Programs a 16-bit half-word at a specified address.

methods.name: FLASH_Program_Byte
methods.description: Programs an 8-bit byte at a specified address.

methods.name: FLASH_SetErrorCode
methods.description: Sets the error code based on flash status flags.

methods.name: FLASH_WaitForLastOperation
methods.description: Waits for the last flash operation to complete or timeout.
